objective: convert public transformer expansion evidence into defensible capacity-sufficiency bounds without inventing plant-stage causal effects
starting_state: v0.10; 47 passing tests; macro import-dependence bound established; stage-level bottleneck unidentified
sources_consulted: DOE Large Power Transformer Resilience Report to Congress, July 2024
APPA report of Siemens Energy Charlotte expansion, 2024-02-16
Hitachi official U.S. manufacturing investment release, 2025-09-04
failures_rejected_approaches: Rejected converting Hitachi investment dollars or job counts into transformer units/year because no defensible conversion is published.
Rejected labeling workforce the binding bottleneck from the 89% hiring-difficulty survey; prevalence is not marginal causal effect.
Rejected treating DOE >60 MVA 2027 demand and Commerce >100 MVA capacity as definition-compatible without qualification.
architectural_decisions: Capacity additions carry product_definition and evidence_id.
Constraint evidence relations distinguish presence, direction, quantified effect, and contradiction.
Cross-definition arithmetic is permitted only as explicitly labeled scenario output.
unresolved_blockers: public unit-rate capacity for major announced expansions
next: build dated plant/order panel and causal event-study harness around observable capacity expansions and lead-time outcomes
